# pve_sdn_subnet (Data Source)

Reads a single SDN subnet object (`GET /cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/subnets/{subnet}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_subnet" "subnet1" {
  vnet   = "vnet1"
  subnet = "10.0.0.0-24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subnet` (String) The subnet identifier in CIDR form; PVE writes the mask separator as a hyphen (for example `10.0.0.0-24`).
- `vnet` (String) The vnet the subnet belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `dhcp_dns_server` (String) IP address of the DHCP DNS server.
- `dhcp_range` (List of String) DHCP ranges for this subnet, each written as `start-end`.
- `dnszoneprefix` (String) DNS domain zone prefix for hostname registration.
- `gateway` (String) Subnet gateway, assigned on the vnet for layer3 zones.
- `snat` (Boolean) Whether masquerade is enabled for this subnet when the pve-firewall is used.
